name: Madness Girlfriend
original_name: マッドネス・ガールフレンド
source:
One day after school,

I was suddenly broken up with.

Shortly after that, I was confessed to Shimonogi Shizuku, a girl in the same club, and we started dating.

But I was starting to feel something wrong.

Since I started dating Shizuku, my surroundings have gotten strange...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21183]Freem![/url]]
translation:
某天放学后，

我突然被甩了。

没过多久，同社团的女孩霜之木雫向我告白，我们就此开始交往。

然而，我渐渐觉得有些不对劲。

自从与雫交往后，我身边的一切就变得古怪起来…

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21183]Freem![/url]]
